comment: The investment case and rationale is well articulated and how it should be pitched to MoF. Would be useful to have/refer to a costing method or approach. In particular it can be hard to answer the TCO of a registry, data exchange or a payment rail - and leaving this at an impasse when MoH and MoF speake with each other.
